title: Swimlane Creator map
description: Neutral process-map format. Author input (text, lane, type, sketch position, arrows, labels) is stored with computed layout values that are always recomputed unless pinned.

phase.description: Optional explicit phase id; otherwise carried forward along the flow

time.description: How long the step takes, e.g. "1 hour", "~2 days", "4-5 weeks". Counted in working hours (8 a day, 5 days a week) and added up along the longest path

broken.description: Something broken: a problem or risk recorded at this step

note.description: A note on the step, shown as a small cloud that opens when pointed at

link.description: A web address (http or https). A link icon on the box opens it

w.description: Written on export. Box width on the board

h.description: Written on export. Box height on the board

sketch.description: Top-left corner of the box on the board, measured from the origin in the middle of the board (author input). x grows right, y grows down

slot.description: 0 = upper half of the row, 1 = lower half

pinned.description: When true the engine must not move this box

layout.description: Computed by the engine, or set by hand and pinned

text.description: Replacement text applied on screen and in exports

kind.description: Optional. Computed from the label and graph when absent

ideal.description: Optional. Computed (shortest plain/yes route) when absent; true forces it

a.description: Face of the 'from' box the arrow leaves. Omit for automatic

b.description: Face of the 'to' box the arrow arrives at. Omit for automatic

sketch.description: How the arrow is drawn on the board (author input)

board.description: Written on export, never read back. Resolved arrow geometry in board coordinates: from {side,x,y}, to {side,x,y}, mid {x,y}

swing.description: Sideways detour in px for a bottom-to-bottom route (negative = left)

labelSegment.description: Index of the line segment that carries the label

n.description: Number of points the route had when it was adjusted. Offsets are ignored when the route has a different shape

s.description: Piece index (0 = the piece leaving the box) to an offset in px, applied square to that piece. On the first and last piece it moves the exit or entry point along the side of the box

nudge.description: Hand adjustments made by dragging the line in the swimlane

origin.description: 0, 0 is the middle of the board. A map without this is re-centred when it is opened

bounds.description: Written on export. x0, y0, x1, y1 of the box that holds every card

columnGaps.description: Extra space before a column index (room for labels or phase gaps)
